title: Feelings and Hopes
label: ch:ta-feelings-and-hopes
canDo: I can say how I felt with eṉakkuk kōpam vantatu and eṉakkuc cantōṣamāka iruntatu, say what I long for with ācai and virumpukiṟēṉ, and name a goal (ilakku) and what I want to become.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 290: say how you felt, what you long for and what you aim to become.
